senses.gloss: m. (סְטֵי) one who diverts judgment from its straight path (= h. מַטֵּה דִין), prevaricator.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 58:6">Targ. Is. LVIII, 6</cite> <he>דין מ׳</he> (h. text <cite ref="M00462"><he>מוֹטָה</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50:3">Gen. R. s. 50</cite> (fictitious name of a Sodomite judge) <he>רב מַסְטֵידִין</he> (= <cite ref="M01902"><he>מַסְטֵי דין</he></cite>, some ed. <cite ref="M01905"><he>מסטירין</he></cite>, corr. acc.) Chief Prevaricator (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:3">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>מצלי דינא</he>); Yalk. ib. 84 (corr. acc.).
